interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repave the degraded sections of the sidewalk with a smooth, continuous concrete surface to eliminate trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Sidewalk repair and widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and widen the sidewalk where possible to improve accessibility and comfort.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular cleaning and maintenance to remove litter and debris from the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical protection and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.
